verdict.rationale: Vanta publishes a documented integrations catalog covering cloud (AWS, Azure), identity providers, code hosting, MDM, and HR/vulnerability/background-check systems (vanta-docs-26, vanta-docs-40, vanta-docs-32, vanta-docs-16, vanta-docs-18), matching the core of the story. However, the evidence never explicitly states that connections use read-only scopes or details ticketing-system integrations specifically, leaving a real gap in the compliance-oriented framing of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of read-only/least-privilege scopes per integration, and explicit mention of ticketing system support.
